query: How do I download/ retrieve Form 5 or Form 5A?
reference_answer: Form 5 or Form 5A refers to the Entry Permit issued to a successful PR applicant upon the completion of PR formalities. You may retrieve your Entry Permit details in ‘MyICA’, under ‘MyTransaction – Entry Permit’ with Singpass login.
